description: RAD51D pathogenic variant spectrum (ClinVar) and pLoF carrier frequency by ancestry (gnomAD v4)
code:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

classes = ["Frameshift","Nonsense","Splice site\n(intronic)","Large indel /\nCNV","Other","Missense"]
counts  = [128, 63, 49, 48, 8, 1]

rows = [("East Asian",288),("Finnish",330),("Middle Eastern",481),("Remaining",656),
        ("South Asian",918),("Non-Finnish Eur.",1507),("Ashkenazi Jewish",1634),
        ("African/Afr-Am",1674),("Admixed American",2485)]

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(14, 5.2))

ax = axes[0]
ax.barh(range(len(classes))[::-1], counts, color=["#2b6cb0"]*4+["#a0aec0","#c53030"])
ax.set_yticks(range(len(classes))[::-1]); ax.set_yticklabels(classes)
for i, c in enumerate(counts):
    ax.text(c+3, len(classes)-1-i, f"{c} ({100*c/sum(counts):.1f}%)", va="center", fontsize=9)
ax.set_xlabel("ClinVar records (n = 297)")
ax.set_title("A. RAD51D pathogenic / likely pathogenic variant classes\nTruncating variants dominate; 1 of 297 is missense", fontsize=11)
ax.set_xlim(0, 165); ax.spines[["top","right"]].set_visible(False)

ax = axes[1]
pops=[r[0] for r in rows]; ns=[r[1] for r in rows]
cols = ["#c53030" if p in ("East Asian","Finnish") else "#2b6cb0" for p in pops]
vals = [1000/n for n in ns]
ax.barh(range(len(pops))[::-1], vals, color=cols)
ax.set_yticks(range(len(pops))[::-1]); ax.set_yticklabels(pops)
for i,(v,n) in enumerate(zip(vals,ns)):
    ax.text(v+0.05, len(pops)-1-i, f"1 in {n}", va="center", fontsize=9)
ax.axvline(1000/1133, ls="--", c="k", lw=1)
ax.text(1000/1133+0.05, 0.1, "overall 1 in 1133", rotation=90, fontsize=8, va="bottom")
ax.set_xlabel("RAD51D pLoF carrier frequency per 1000 people")
ax.set_title("B. gnomAD v4 carrier frequency by genetic ancestry\nFounder alleles raise East Asian and Finnish rates", fontsize=11)
ax.set_xlim(0, 4.8); ax.spines[["top","right"]].set_visible(False)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
